# JavaScript and TypeScript corpus fixtures

Trimmed snapshots of real repositories of different shapes, used by
`tests/corpus_js.rs` to check that diagrams read the way a developer would
describe each codebase. Binary files and lockfiles are left out; each keeps
its license file.

| Fixture | Source | Commit | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| express-api | github.com/hagopj13/node-express-boilerplate (`src/`, `bin/`, manifests) | 179ae84 | MIT |
| nextjs-app | github.com/shadcn-ui/taxonomy (Next.js App Router app, Prisma, components) | 298a885 | MIT |
| nestjs-cats | github.com/nestjs/nest (`sample/01-cats-app`) | 2731c18 | MIT |
| react-vite | github.com/alan2207/bulletproof-react (`apps/react-vite`, trimmed `src/`) | 9506629 | MIT |
| ky | github.com/sindresorhus/ky (`source/`) | 3541888 | MIT |
| serve | github.com/vercel/serve (`source/`) | 37b3a74 | MIT |
| turborepo-basic | github.com/vercel/turborepo (`examples/basic`, a pnpm workspace) | 27ed5b3 | MIT |
